diversity_concentration(): 渔获量的多样性与集中度

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/diversity_concentration.Rmd
diversity_concentration.Rmd

英文原页：diversity_concentration()

说明

该函数逐年计算：

  • 上报的物种数（有渔获量且鉴定到种的条目数）和有渔获量的国家数；
  • 基于FAO物种条目计算的渔获量香农多样性指数H = -\sum p_i \ln p_i，其中p_i为条目i的占比；
  • 物种条目和国家的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），即各百分比占比的平方和（取值0至10 000；通常认为高于2 500为高度集中）；
  • 最大的top_n个物种条目和国家所占的比例。
English

This function computes, for each year:

  • the number of species reported (items identified to species with catch) and the number of countries with catch;
  • the Shannon diversity index of the catch over FAO species items, H = -\sum p_i \ln p_i, where p_i is the share of item i;
  • the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI) of species items and of countries, the sum of squared percentage shares (0 to 10 000; above 2 500 is usually read as highly concentrated);
  • the share of the top_n largest species items and countries.

用法 

diversity_concentration(
  area_data,
  top_n = 5,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  label = NULL
)

参数

area_data
FAO渔获数据：fishing_area_data()$area_data，或load_fao_data()的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。
English FAO catch data: fishing_area_data()$area_data, or any subset of load_fao_data() (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).
top_n
计算前几名所占比例时取的最大物种数和国家数。默认为5。
English The number of largest species and countries for the top share. Default is 5.
plot
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，图表保存在figures/png/summary/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), charts are saved in figures/png/summary/.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)为所有函数统一更改。
English A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/summary/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).
label
输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。
English The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the country) of the data.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每年一行。

English

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per year.

另请参阅

Other summary analyses: area_overview(), coastal_distant(), country_group_summary(), data_quality(), peak_trend(), regime_shift(), species_group_composition(), stock_status()

示例 

FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central", plot = FALSE)
diversity_concentration(FAO34$area_data, lang = "zh")
